description: Canonical puzzle/solution catalog plus solver retrieval, replay-backed fragment flow and empirical composition priors for Opus Magnum Codex.

identity.canonicalStructuralHash: translation/rotation invariant hash preserving program timing
identity.canonicalMechanismHash: translation/rotation invariant hash with normalized program timing
identity.puzzleFeatureFingerprint: hash of solver-relevant puzzle chemistry, molecule topology, available parts and production constraints

fragmentIndex.purpose: Catalog reusable local functional sub-mechanisms extracted from historical solutions.

fragmentFlowIndex.purpose: Catalog replay-observed composition transitions between canonical functional fragment mechanisms.
fragmentFlowIndex.lineage: Atom ids persist across replay molecule merge/split operations and are used as lineage markers.

compositionPrior.purpose: Rank historically observed fragment chains as solver composition priors.
compositionPrior.cyclePolicy: A fragment mechanism may appear at most once in a candidate chain.
limitations: The composition prior is empirical and chemistry-agnostic until joined to the target puzzle feature model.
Unsupported replay glyphs reduce available transition coverage.
A ranked chain is a strategy prior, not yet a placed or collision-valid solution.
